price_field_note: The Uptown 2026 RETAIL Price Book publishes a single Retail Price column (consumer/retail pricing) distributed via Associated Energy Systems. No dealer/wholesale column is published, so msrp is populated and dealer_price left null. NOTE: Uptown UE-series fireplaces are luxury ELECTRIC fireplaces (Flicker Flame / LCD / Holographic), not direct-vent gas. The task brief described them as Kingsman-family premium direct-vent gas; that is incorrect per the price book and BSC brand card. fuel_type is set to electric and ignition to null accordingly.
